name: Handy — AI + Live Experts for Every Fix

mentions.name: Handy — AI + Live Experts for Every Fix
mentions.description: This platform connects DIY consumers with verified home-improvement professionals through on-demand live video consultations for a fee, anywhere in the USA. HandyLens AI analyzes the camera view, highlights problem areas, and guides both consumer and pro with contextual prompts, with specialized AI packs for plumbing, electrical, HVAC, painting and other domains. Each session ends with an AI-generated "Fix Report" covering what to do, parts needed, and next steps, and the platform integrates retailer catalogs for instant part links while capturing verified pro ratings and summaries.
mentions.audience: DIY consumers and home-improvement professionals across the USA
mentions.source_excerpt: I have built a AI powered home improvement platform with live consultation with pros.
